grammar.title: Reporting hearsay with 听说
grammar.explanation: 听说 (tīngshuō) means "I heard (that)..., it's said that..." used to share information you got from someone else, not something you know firsthand.

grammar.title: Getting used to something with 习惯
grammar.explanation: 习惯 (xíguàn) can be a noun ("habit") or a verb ("to be used to, to get accustomed to"). As a verb it is followed directly by a verb phrase or a noun.

sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè běn shū hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.en: I heard this book is very famous.
I heard it will rain tomorrow.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō tā huàn gōngzuò le.

sentences.en: I'm used to getting up early.

sentences.zh: 他还不习惯这里的天气。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hái bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
sentences.en: He's not used to the weather here yet.

sentences.pinyin: Màn màn nǐ jiù xíguàn le.
sentences.en: Little by little you'll get used to it.
